name: update_findings_summary
description: Modify the Summary section of findings.md. action='replace': overwrite entire summary with content. action='append': add a new line at the end of the summary. action='remove': delete all lines whose text contains content (substring match).

action.description: replace: overwrite entire summary. append: add a line. remove: delete lines containing content.

content.description: For replace: full new summary text. For append: the line to add. For remove: substring to match against lines to delete.
